trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: If I would have known, I would help you now.
trap.right: If I had known, I would help you now.
trap.why: Revisão: 3º (had + part., would have + part.) e misto (had + part., would + base). O brasileiro usa would na if.

mcq.q: If we had left earlier, we **___** the train.
If I had slept, I **___** awake now.

opts: If I had known, I would have called.
If I knew, I would call.
If I know, I will call.
If he trained, he’d be fit.
If he trains, he’ll be fit.
If he had trained, he would be fitter now.

fix.wrong: If we would have left, we caught the train.
fix.right: If we had left, we would have caught the train.

fix.wrong: If I had known, I helped you.
fix.right: If I had known, I would have helped you.

fix.wrong: If she had trained, she will be fit now.
fix.right: If she had trained, she would be fit now.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o 3º: “If I know, I call.”
rewrite.answer: If I had known, I would have called.

rewrite.prompt: Misto: “If he trained, he is fitter.” (had)
rewrite.answer: If he had trained, he would be fitter.

rewrite.prompt: Negativa: “If I had known, I would have called.” (wouldn’t)
rewrite.answer: If I had known, I wouldn’t have called.
